title: security-event.v1
description: Security event emitted by the primitive or broker to the audit sink. Sensitive payloads never enter diagnostics. Audit failure cannot turn denial into allow. Security maintainers approve redaction schema; sinks ignore additive fields and reject unknown major versions.

schema_version.description: Schema major version. Sinks ignore additive fields and reject unknown major versions.

operation_id.description: Stable unique identifier for the security-sensitive operation this event records.

correlation_id.description: Correlation identifier linking this event to its originating capability grant or request.

event_type.description: Type of security event (e.g., file-read, file-write, process-launch, capability-issue, policy-denial).

outcome.description: Whether the operation was allowed or denied. A denial code is required when outcome is denied.

reason_code.description: Stable, redacted reason code for the outcome. No sensitive payloads, request content, or personal identifiers.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 instant when this event was emitted, before the operation was acknowledged.
